拉力试验机

恒温恒湿箱

合作方式

图纸或样品确认

按图纸或样品开模；只有样品时先做 3D 扫描和逆向建模，图纸确认后再开模。

开模与试模

T1 试模后 3 天内寄出样品和全尺寸检测报告，每套模具含 3 次试模。

批量注塑

模具确认后 15–20 天交付批量注塑件。

出货检验

外观与功能全检，出货抽检并附检测报告。

认证状态

模具与注塑件业务的体系认证状态。

ISO 9001

已有

ISO 14001

已有

IATF 16949

认证中

常见问题

没有图纸只有样品能开模吗？

可以，先做 3D 扫描和逆向建模，图纸确认后再开模。

开模周期多久？

单腔模具约 25–35 天，多腔热流道和双色模具约 40–55 天，从图纸确认开始计。

试模样品怎么提供？

T1 试模后 3 天内寄出样品和全尺寸检测报告，每套模具含 3 次试模。

模具归谁所有？

模具费付清后模具归买方所有，可存放在本厂用于批量生产。

出口订单用什么贸易条款？

常用 FOB 宁波和 EXW，也可按订单约定 CIF。

询盘

把图纸或样品需求发到邮箱，我们按图纸或样品开模，并承接批量注塑。

Tensile testing machines

Constant temperature and humidity chambers

How We Work

Drawing or sample confirmation

Mold making based on drawings or samples; if only a sample is available, 3D scanning and reverse modeling are done first, and mold making starts after the drawing is confirmed.

Mold making and trials

Samples and full-dimensional inspection reports are sent out within 3 days after the T1 trial; each mold includes 3 trials.

Volume injection molding

Volume injection molded parts are delivered 15–20 days after mold approval.

Shipment inspection

Full inspection of appearance and function, with sampling inspection before shipment and inspection reports attached.

Certification Status

System certification status for the mold and injection molded parts business.

ISO 9001

Obtained

ISO 14001

Obtained

IATF 16949

In certification

FAQ

Can molds be made from a sample without drawings?

Yes. 3D scanning and reverse modeling are done first, and mold making starts after the drawing is confirmed.

How long does mold making take?

About 25–35 days for single-cavity molds and about 40–55 days for multi-cavity hot runner and two-color molds, counted from drawing confirmation.

How are trial samples provided?

Samples and full-dimensional inspection reports are sent out within 3 days after the T1 trial; each mold includes 3 trials.

Who owns the mold?

After the mold fee is paid in full, the mold belongs to the buyer and can be stored at our plant for volume production.

What trade terms are used for export orders?

Commonly FOB Ningbo and EXW, CIF also available as agreed per order.

Inquiry

Send your drawing or sample requirements to our email; we make molds based on drawings or samples and also handle volume injection molding.
